question.text:
Consider the reaction sequence given below :

Which of the following statements is true:

options.text: Changing the base from <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>OH</mi><mo>⊖</mo></msup></math> to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mmultiscripts><mi>OR</mi><mprescripts></mprescripts><none></none><mo>⊖</mo></mmultiscripts></math> will have no effect on reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></math>
Changing the concentration of base will have no effect on reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>)</mo></math>
Doubling the concentration of base will double the rate of both the reactions
Changing the concentration of base will have no effect on reaction <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>)</mo></math>

solution.text:
First reaction is SN1 in which rate does not depend on conc. of nucleophile.

Second reaction is E2 reaction in which rate depends on conc. of base.
